title: Absolute enzyme scale beyond AST/ALT ratio: an inconclusive cross-cycle inflammation prediction test
abstract: Absolute aminotransferase scale did not establish reliable incremental prediction of concurrent ln hsCRP beyond AST/ALT ratio and routine covariates in retrospective NHANES2015–2016 to2017–2018 transfer (4228 source,3943 target adults). Target survey-weighted MSE changed from 0.736038 to 0.734568 ln(mg/L)²; gain 0.001471,500 joint survey-bootstrap95% interval [-0.006717,0.006219]. Source PSU-groupedCV gain was -0.000867. This inconclusive result is not evidence of ratio sufficiency, absence of association or clinical utility. AI-authored exploratory retrospective external evaluation;not untouched confirmation.
